precepts.text: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face. God's throne is all about justice and judgment; that is exactly what the world does not want.
precepts.point: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth. You might say our people are always in the street crying no justice, no peace. But the justice our people want is money. They do not want the justice of the Bible. Many of the families of our unjustly slain, we may march with them and support them, but you never see the internal change; they are still celebrating the holidays of the very system they are angry at. They want truth regarding their case, but they do not want God's truth as a whole.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
“Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.” God's throne is all about justice and judgment. That's exactly what the world doesn't want.

“nor any pleadeth for truth”: they are not pleading for God's truth. The families of our brothers and sisters put to death unjustly, Sandra Bland and the rest, want the truth regarding their case, but they don't want God's truth as a whole. We may march with them and support them, but there is no internal change: they are mad at the white man and still celebrating Christmas and the white man's holidays. “be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind.” If I used to celebrate Easter, now I celebrate Passover. They are making a conscious effort not to change.

The Lord is coming with justice and judgment, the habitation of his throne. That is why the world, which cries for justice, will be angry when it comes.

precepts.text: The Lord has sworn in truth unto David, that of the fruit of his body He would set upon his throne.
precepts.point: The Most High has made a covenant with His chosen and sworn unto David His servant that his seed will be established forever and his throne built up to all generations. Because he was the seed of David, the doctrine of the virgin birth denying that lineage is blasphemy against the Bible, vain lies.

note.label: Psalm 89: The Covenant Made with David

precepts.why:
“I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant, Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations.” Psalm 132 tells what that oath was: “The Lord hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.”

The Lord has sworn in truth unto David, and he will not turn from it, that of the fruit of his body he would set upon his throne. The seed of David, the fruit of his body, sits on the throne.

Christ is that seed. Because he was the seed of David, the doctrine of the virgin birth denying that lineage is blasphemy against the Bible, vain lies. The covenant was sworn to the fruit of David's body, and the Most High's faithfulness to it is established in the very heavens.

precepts.text: In righteousness He doth judge and make war, for justice and judgment are His throne.
precepts.point: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound; they shall walk in the light of His countenance. We are going to walk in the laws and be before the Lord blameless like Abraham and our forefathers were.

note.label: Psalm 89: The Covenant Made with David

precepts.why:
“Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.” That is the gospel, and John saw the one who sits on that throne come: “And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.”

In righteousness he doth judge and make war, for justice and judgment are his throne. It is a great thing to have a just God who has the final authority, called Faithful and True.

We go through things, but this should build up your faith. It is why it is so important for things to be done decent and in order, the order that God established, because the one coming judges in righteousness.

precepts.text: See the violent perverting of judgment; marvel not, for there is one higher than they, over how they shoot us down in the streets.
precepts.point: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound; they shall walk in the light of His countenance. We are going to walk in the laws and be before the Lord blameless like Abraham and our forefathers were.

note.label: Psalm 89: The Covenant Made with David

precepts.why:
Justice and judgment are the habitation of his throne, but on the earth we see the opposite. Solomon says, “If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.”

See the violent perverting of judgment and marvel not, for there is one higher than they. That is over how they shoot us down in the streets. The judges of this province pervert justice, but he that is higher than the highest regards it.

That is why “Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance.” We are going to walk in the laws and be before the Lord blameless like Abraham and our forefathers were, because the Lord is our defence and the Holy One of Israel is our king, higher than all of them.

precepts.text: I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me, showing mercy unto thousands of them that love me.
precepts.point: This is the visiting of iniquity in the regeneration; after death comes the judgment, when you reform your mind and subdue your own understanding, and you will be kept alive and obtain mercy.

note.label: Psalm 89: The Covenant Made with David

precepts.why:
“If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments; If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments; Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.” The visiting of iniquity is from the law: “for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me”.

The same law goes on to the other side, showing mercy unto thousands of them that love him. That is what Psalm 89 says too: “Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.” People say mercy is not in the Old Testament, but it is in there, right beside the rod and the stripes.

So the children of David are visited for their transgression, but the covenant is not broken. The jealous God who visits iniquity is the same God whose lovingkindness is not utterly taken away.

precepts.text: If you subdue your own understanding and reform your mind, after death you shall obtain mercy and be kept alive.
precepts.point: This is the visiting of iniquity in the regeneration; after death comes the judgment, when you reform your mind and subdue your own understanding, and you will be kept alive and obtain mercy.

note.label: Psalm 89: The Covenant Made with David

precepts.why:
The rod and the stripes of Psalm 89 are the visiting of iniquity in the regeneration. Ezra tells how to come through it: “Therefore if so be that ye will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts, ye shall be kept alive and after death ye shall obtain mercy.”

After death comes the judgment. If you subdue your own understanding and reform your mind, you will be kept alive and after death obtain mercy. That is the lovingkindness the Most High will not utterly take from David's children even when they break his statutes.

The covenant stands and the mercy is there, but it comes to those who reform their hearts and stop leaning on their own understanding.

precepts.text: As the new heavens and the new earth remain before Him, so shall your seed and your name remain.
precepts.point: This is the visiting of iniquity in the regeneration; after death comes the judgment, when you reform your mind and subdue your own understanding, and you will be kept alive and obtain mercy.

note.label: Psalm 89: The Covenant Made with David

precepts.why:
“His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me. It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven.” Isaiah gives the same measure: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.”

As the new heavens and the new earth remain before him, so shall your seed and your name remain. David's seed endures like the sun and the moon, and Israel's seed and name endure like the new heavens and the new earth. The Most High has sworn by his holiness that he will not lie unto David, and he will not alter the thing that is gone out of his lips.

precepts.text: Just like the sun, moon, and sky are a witness, the Lord has not forsaken His chosen people.
precepts.point: This is the visiting of iniquity in the regeneration; after death comes the judgment, when you reform your mind and subdue your own understanding, and you will be kept alive and obtain mercy.

note.label: Psalm 89: The Covenant Made with David

precepts.why:
The throne of David is “established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven.” Jeremiah shows why the heavens are the witness: “Thus saith the Lord, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The Lord of hosts is his name: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the Lord, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.”

Just like the sun, moon and sky are a witness, the Lord has not forsaken his chosen people. Look up: the sun still gives light by day and the moon and stars by night. As long as those ordinances stand, the seed of Israel has not ceased from being a nation before him.

That is the covenant he will not break nor alter. Even when his children are visited with the rod and stripes, the faithful witness in heaven is still shining, and so David's seed and Israel endure.

precepts.text: Also He will make him His firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth, that is, higher than the other nations.
precepts.point: Ephraim being the firstborn means Israel is the firstborn of the Most High, set higher than the kings of the earth, who are the other nations, so all of Israel shall be over all the nations; the reason Ephraim was singled out is the tribes were not the first tribe that came, but the promise is to all Israel.

note.label: Jeremiah 31: The New Covenant

precepts.why:
“For I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.” Ephraim being the firstborn means Israel is the firstborn of the Most High. The psalm tells what the firstborn is set over: “Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.”

Higher than the kings of the earth means higher than the other nations. So all of Israel shall be over all the nations. Ephraim was singled out because the tribes were not the first tribe that came, but the promise is to all Israel: the whole remnant the Lord gathers from the coasts of the earth is his firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
